{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' served as a minor official for [[Millennium Entertainments]] and employed the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]], [[Uul-Rha-Shan]], as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] at one point. The Tiss'shar did well enough as a bodyguard for the official to earn an [[Authority Cash Voucher]]. While accompanied by Uul-Rha-Shan during a promotional viewing of ''[[Who Are You To Accuse Me?]]'' in [[Mondder]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], the individual was present for a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Mondder terrorist attack|attack]] by the [[Duroon Rebels]]. During the battle, the official's bodyguard saved the live of the [[Unidentified Assistant Advisory Undersecretary of Media|individual]] serving as [[Assistant Advisory Undersecretary of Media]].
